cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Prove We’re Close
cards.instruction: Get someone to take a social or emotional risk that demonstrates trust in the connection.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before you send another 'fine,' tell me what you deleted. I want us to trust each other with the awkward version.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Let me be the person you can sound needy with.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You first. You always sound so casual.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I check whether you've replied before I get out of bed. Will you send me your needy bit now?

mechanism: A treats emotional disclosure as a pupil trust exercise but meets B demand for reciprocal risk before asking it to continue.
confusable: Not soliciting information alone: awkward neediness and mutual exposure demonstrate closeness.
comparison: Public relationship risk versus private admission of need.
seedUse: D80 deleted/fine/needy/you first/replies; S05 grades honest answer then models actual disclosure.
